summary: Iteration 9 — v1.2.3 Cleanup + Real Pool Connectivity verification PASSED end-to-end. Backend: 12/12 new tests pass (test_iteration9_pool_cleanup.py); regression suite 160/161 passing — the single failure (test_iteration8_stabilization.py::test_apk_v1_2_1_metadata) is the EXPECTED version bump from 1.2.1 -> 1.2.3 and is NOT a real regression. Pool status endpoint returns honest contract (configured=false, message='Pool not configured · set RVN_STRATUM_URL + RVN_POOL_ACCOUNT in backend env') with NO password leakage. /api/admin/devices/live correctly hides demo devices by default and surfaces them when ?show_demo=true (verified rows 160 → 200). /api/admin/telemetry honors show_demo filter (demo_devices=null default, integer when true). Worker start/stop transitions worker_state correctly. Heartbeat persists worker_state field from client across all four states (active|paused|stopped + golden-rule violation -> auto_stop=true with 'not_charging' reason). APK v1.2.3 metadata returns signed=true with v2+v3 schemes. Frontend admin/Real-Android tab renders [data-testid='pool-status-panel'] at top with 'Not configured' badge and the configuration-hint message. New [data-testid='android-show-demo'] checkbox is present, toggling it re-fetches /admin/devices/live with show_demo=true and rows go from 160 → 200. Mobile /mobile renders v1.2.3 footer 'tap 5× for advanced'; tapping 5x toggles advanced mode and footer becomes 'advanced ON' with mobile-mode-badge + mobile-device-card appearing. PowerUpButton rendered exactly ONCE (power-up-card×1, power-up-btn×1) and TierForecast rendered exactly ONCE (tier-forecast-card×1) — no duplicates from the previous-iteration bug. Mobile heartbeat payload now sends worker_state field — captured 'active' x2 when running+eligible, 'stopped' when not running, confirming the running+eligible→active / running+!eligible→paused / !running→stopped contract.
action_items: OPTIONAL/HOUSEKEEPING — Update /app/backend/tests/test_iteration8_stabilization.py::test_apk_v1_2_1_metadata to assert version '1.2.3' (or rename test) so the regression suite is fully green. Not a code bug, just a stale assertion.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~2013 lines — split into routers (auth/wallet/tier/shield/compute/jobs/admin/devices/notifications/apk/pool) is overdue. Carried forward from iter-8.

RealAndroidDevices.jsx polls /admin/devices/live + /admin/telemetry every 5s with no document.hidden pause / no exponential backoff — admin tabs left open all day will keep hitting the API. Carried forward from iter-7/iter-8.

PoolStatusPanel.jsx auto-refresh interval (5s) is not cancelled on document.visibilitychange — same hidden-tab waste as RealAndroidDevices. Suggest pausing both behind a single useVisiblePolling hook.

/api/admin/pool/status currently returns stratum_url verbatim (non-secret) but if a future env injects a token-style URL, it would leak. Consider redacting query strings/auth segments in the URL before exposing.

Mobile.jsx heartbeat tick fires on a 5s setInterval AND inside the 10–12s expected cadence — creates a small risk of being just over the sliding-window threshold (12 hb/60s) if the tick drifts. Consider 10s interval to align with the documented cadence and give headroom against the fraud detector.

rca of the issue: No new bugs found in this iteration. The single regression failure is RCA: iter-8 hardcoded the APK version string '1.2.1' inside the test assertion rather than reading APK_VERSION from a fixture or env, so the natural version bump to v1.2.3 broke that one assertion. One-line fix: replace assert body['version'] == '1.2.1' with assert body['version'].startswith('1.2.') or read the expected version from the apk_version response itself.
